adapted: Hermes Agent Bot Desktop runtime, lease/lock, display allocation and thumbnail concepts; rewritten in TypeScript for Briefsip.

takeover.logic: Hermes single-holder lease, persistent holder/since/epoch, request reason, and tool-level human-control fence translated into TypeScript. Briefsip uses SQLite revisions, its own durable turn pause/resume journal, screenshot hand-back note, SSE transport and three-viewer cap; no Hermes runtime or UI copied.
